text: The first piece in chess are pawns. They can move one square forwards, and capture diagonally. However, they can promote once they reach the end of the board, and can move two squares forwards on the first move!
The bishop is a more powerful piece! They can move any number of squares at once, but only diagonally! However, it can't move through pieces.
The knight can move in an L shape, and jump over pieces!
Like a bishop, a rook can move any number of squares horizontally or vertically!
The queen is your most powerful piece. It moves any number of squares horizontally, vertically or even diagonally! Therefore, it moves like a rook and a bishop combined.
The king is your most important piece. Despite it being weak, if you can't defend your king, you lose!
Your king can also perform a special move if your king and rook's havent moved called castling!
Pawns also have a special move! If an enemy pawn moves two squares on the last move, and you could have captured them if they moved one, you can capture them anyways!
